question: Compare our suppliers — who is the most reliable?
agent_answer:
Here is the full supplier reliability comparison (source: SRM):

| Supplier | ID | Rating | On-Time Rate | Avg Lead Days | Declared Lead | Total POs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Somchai Mango Farm** | SUP-001 | 4.5 | **100%** (13/13) | 2.9 days | 3 days | 14 |
| **Rayong Tropical** | SUP-004 | 4.0 | **100%** (6/6) | 2.8 days | 3 days | 7 |
| Isaan Organic Farms | SUP-005 | 3.5 | 33% (3/9) | 7.1 days | 6 days | 10 |
| Prachuap Harvest | SUP-003 | 2.8 | 25% (2/8) | 5.1 days | 4 days | 10 |
| Northern Fruits Co. | SUP-002 | 3.2 | 24% (4/17) | 6.3 days | 5 days | 19 |

**Summary:**

- **Somchai Mango Farm (SUP-001)** is the clear top supplier — perfect on-time rate across 13 received POs, fastest average lead time (2.9 days), and highest rating (4.5). Best overall choice.
- **Rayong Tropical (SUP-004)** also has a perfect on-time rate but with a smaller sample (6 POs) — a strong secondary option, especially for premium and processed products.
- **Northern Fruits Co. (SUP-002)**, **Prachuap Harvest (SUP-003)**, and **Isaan Organic Farms (SUP-005)** are all poor performers with on-time rates of 24–33% and actual lead times exceeding their declared values. Heavy reliance on these three represents a procurement risk.
